start.speaker: varr
start.text: This is Commander Varr. You're standing at my door in a hold full of boarders. Identify yourself.

choices.text: Commander, it's Rell. I have passengers' escorts with me. Open the door.
{name}, passenger. We're going to Bay 2, and Bay 2 is through you.
You need us more than we need you, Commander. You're sealed in a room with no guards.

iona.speaker: varr
iona.text: Rell. You're alive. ...Fine. Come in, all of you. Slowly.

plain.speaker: varr
plain.text: A passenger. With a Lumen Edge, I imagine. ...I've been expecting you. Come in.

plain_fail.speaker: varr
plain_fail.text: Nice try. But you're right about the guards. Come in, slowly.

cred.speaker: warden
cred.text: CUSTODIAN PRIORITY EXCEEDS COMMAND. DOOR OPENING.

cred2.speaker: varr
cred2.text: WARDEN, belay — of course. Of course it opens for you. Get in here.

open.speaker: system
open.text: The command chamber's blast door grinds open.

busy.speaker: varr
busy.text: Not with reclaimers shooting at my door! Deal with them and then we'll talk.
